mapper.select: SELECT ci.id, ci.cart_id, ci.menu_id, ci.quantity, ci.total_price, ci.special_request, ci.created_at, ci.updated_at, m.name as menu_name, m.image_url as menu_image, m.price as menu_price, cio.id as option_id, cio.cart_item_id, cio.option_id as option_id_ref, cio.option_name, cio.option_value, cio.option_price FROM tb_cart_item ci LEFT JOIN tb_menus m ON ci.menu_id = m.id LEFT JOIN tb_cart_item_option cio ON ci.id = cio.cart_item_id WHERE ci.id = #{id} ORDER BY cio.id ASC

SELECT ci.id, ci.cart_id, ci.menu_id, ci.quantity, ci.total_price, ci.special_request, ci.created_at, ci.updated_at, m.name as menu_name, m.image_url as menu_image, m.price as menu_price, cio.id as option_id, cio.cart_item_id, cio.option_id as option_id_ref, cio.option_name, cio.option_value, cio.option_price FROM tb_cart_item ci LEFT JOIN tb_menus m ON ci.menu_id = m.id LEFT JOIN tb_cart_item_option cio ON ci.id = cio.cart_item_id WHERE ci.cart_id = #{cartId} ORDER BY ci.created_at ASC, cio.id ASC
SELECT id, cart_item_id, option_id, option_name, option_value, option_price FROM tb_cart_item_option WHERE cart_item_id = #{cartItemId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: /* SQL ID: cartDao.insert SQL 명: 장바구니 아이템 생성 */ INSERT INTO tb_cart_item (cart_id, menu_id, quantity, total_price, special_request, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{cartId}, #{menuId}, #{quantity}, #{totalPrice}, #{specialRequest}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO tb_cart_item_option (cart_item_id, option_id, option_name, option_value, option_price) VALUES (#{cartItemId}, #{optionId}, #{optionName}, #{optionValue}, #{optionPrice})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_cart_item SET quantity = #{quantity}, total_price = #{totalPrice}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
